findings.message: apps/server/src/MatchRoom.ts worldTick/stepReveals: targeted rumor requests still pending in RumorBook when the flow ends are never answered (stepReveals only runs while flow.end === null and nothing refuses the leftovers), so those players get no rumor-result and the client only frees its Buy buttons via its 5 s PENDING_TIMEOUT_TICKS. No gold is taken, so this is cosmetic, but a final 'not-in-play' answer would close the request cleanly.
findings.requirement: The restored feature meets all of `features/intel-online/game-task.md`'s acceptance, including its branch table `docs/intel-online-coverage.md`.

findings.message: apps/server/src/MatchRoom.ts arriveRumor / apps/server/src/intel.ts RumorBook.decided: a decided (player, request id) is replayed regardless of the type in the new request, so a retried id naming a different type gets the earlier type's decision and lead resent, unlike the ledger's own contract (a reused id for another item is 'duplicate'). The browser always sends fresh ids, so there is no player-facing impact today; worth aligning before economy-online's shop reuses this purchase path.
